Picked Otago Exercise Programme: Otago is the falls-prevention standard for an older or frail adult. It progresses by level, not load, matching low-impact needs.

Day Strength and balance session - 11 exercises. knee extension (quads) Leg Extensions level 0, 2x10; knee flexion (hamstrings) Standing Leg Curl level 0, 2x10; hip abduction Otago Hip Abduction level 0, 2x10 (+8 more)\nReadiness 1-5? (skip if you like)
Picked Couch to 5k: Couch to 5k is the standard sedentary-to-5k on-ramp. No equipment needed, and it matches a running or cardio goal directly.
